newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's BTC to raise its equity.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's BTC to raise its equity.

text.p: Slovenian warehouse and shopping centre operator BTC said on Thursday it would raise its equity capital by 1.83 billion tolars to 6.64 billion tolars.
The company said in a statement it would issue 229,267 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 8,000 tolars each, extending the number of its shares to 830,000.
BTC said it expects to issue new shares in June and sell them to a limited number of subscribers, but gave no further details. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
